verdict.rationale: The evidence documents self-hostable components across the stack: Grafana OSS, Loki storing chunks in S3/GCS or a local filesystem, Mimir as horizontally scalable and highly available, Tempo on open tracing protocols, and monolithic single-binary modes, which a community user confirms self-hosting for Loki. However, architecture and upgrade documentation are only evidenced for Loki, and users report upgrade friction and multi-service sprawl. Missing for 10: production deployment and architecture docs for the whole stack (Grafana, Mimir, Tempo), a documented cross-stack upgrade path, and independent corroboration of production-scale self-hosted operation.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can run the full observability stack self-hosted in production with documented architecture and upgrade path
